title: HandLive — relay op error (relay → device)
description: 0.7.3, CONN-03 API 5, PAIR-01 API 7: a frame the relay refused. message is an English diagnostic for logs, never shown (0.12.4). The HTTP error body of the REST API is relay-rest.schema.json#/$defs/error-response.

code.description: NOT_PAIRED (0.8.2): the destination is not the peer of a registered, unrevoked pair (also the sender itself); NOT_CONNECTED (0.8.1): no receiver on dev:<to>, the frame could not be published, or an rv_msg without another member; PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE: frame > 256 KiB; RATE_LIMITED; BAD_REQUEST: malformed wrapper or HR frame (a destination that is not a UUIDv8 included), or a full rendezvous.

to.description: Destination of the refused frame, when there is one; never with BAD_REQUEST, so a malformed id is never echoed (CONN-03 API 6 logic 1).
